title: Admissão Digital (domínio rh_admissao)
summary: Especificação do módulo de admissão digital: coleta de documentos, exame, contrato, efetivação transacional em colaborador e eventos eSocial.
notes: Dominant signals are technical contracts: data entities/schemas (processo_admissao, ficha_cadastral_admissao, link_admissao, etc.), state machines, permission matrix, integration contracts and regulatory constraints → SPEC. Also carries PRD-like numbered functionalities and one open architectural decision ('construir × contratar', explicitly unresolved) — not an Accepted ADR, so not locked. Status header reads 'PROPOSTA — nada definitivo'. Chose SPEC over PRD because entity/contract detail dominates over user-story framing.
